This appeal is filed by the defendant under Section 96 r/w. Order XLI of Civil Procedure Code challenging the judgment and decree dated 13.09.2022 passed by the XXVIII Additional City Civil Judge (CCH-29), Bangalore in O.S.No.25737/2013, whereby the suit was decreed.

3. The brief facts of the case are that the plaintiffs have filed a suit for recovery of possession in respect of the suit schedule property in O.S.No.25737/2013 and the same has been decreed on 13.09.2022.
Being aggrieved, the defendant has filed this appeal.
4. Sri K.R.Chandrashekara Reddy filed vakalath for respondents.
The parties have filed IA No.1/2023 (compromise application) under Order XXIII Rule 3 of Civil Procedure Code.
The compromise application is duly signed by the plaintiffs and the defendants.
They have been identified by their respective counsel.
The application is taken on record and the same is extracted below:
"1. The respondents father Sri. Late Siddaramaiah was the absolute owner of land bearing Sy.No.2/3 of Pattanagere, Kengeri Hobli, Bengaluru South Taluk, measuring 2 acres 16 guntas.

The said land and land in various other survey numbers was acquired vide notification number RD178AQB84 dated: 30.07.1987 for forming residential layout by the REMCO (BHEL) House Building Co-Operative Society.
The appellant was also one of the members of the said society.
The said land acquisition was challenged by land owners by filing Writ Petition/s before the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka at Bengaluru.
